title: Trickbetrug durch falsche Polizeibeamte – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?

extraction.summaryEn: Police are running a public appeal for information about a suspect in a fraud case where people posing as police officers tricked a victim, which took place in Biesdorf on 18 September 2025. One of two men shown in the earlier appeal has been ruled out, and the search for the other continues.
